name: The Samaritan Inn Food Pantry
hoursNotes: Closed 1–1:30pm Tue–Thu for restocking. Saturday mobile pantry stops at several McKinney churches — see website for the schedule.
requirements: New clients bring photo ID and proof of current address (digital photos accepted; proof of address waived for unhoused individuals). Serves northern Collin County communities.
notes: Formerly Community Lifeline Center, integrated into The Samaritan Inn in late 2025; grocery-style pantry plus homelessness prevention and rent/utility assistance.
